headline: Carhenge / Shandoka goes before Planning & Zoning Commission on Thursday, July 23
blurb: Three Town-owned development projects dominate this agenda — all in the Accommodations 2 zone, all designed by Design Workshop, all on land the Town itself owns. The Carhenge Redevelopment Project gets two bites of the apple: a Preliminary Large Scale Subdivision to consolidate Lots 34 and 34B at 700 W Pacific Ave into a single parcel over 15,000 sq ft, and a Conceptual PUD for new construction on that consolidated lot (carried over from May).
